title: Create Infinity By Alperca
description: The ultimate 1.21.1 Create experience. Automate heavy industry with TFMG, build functional airships with Create Aeronautics, and launch into the cosmos with Creating Space.
body:
# Conquer the Skies and Beyond
The core experience revolves around movement and physics with Create Aeronautics.  
- Build functional aircraft and airships using Man of Many Planes or construct intricate flying contraptions that utilize real physics. 
- Advance your technology to leave the atmosphere and explore the cosmos with Creating Space.

# Advanced Industrial Engineering
The pack includes a comprehensive suite of tools to automate your world:
- The Factory Must Grow (TFMG): Implements heavy industry and advanced resource processing.  
- Create New Age: Adds electricity and modern energy systems to your kinetic networks.  
- Big Cannons and Diesel Generators: Provides the firepower and fuel needed for large-scale operations.  

# World and Survival Enhancements
While engineering is the focus, the world is filled with detail and optimization:
- Culinary Automation: Features an extensive collection of Delight mods such as Farmer's Delight, End's Delight, and Pizza Delight.  
- Visual Fidelity: Optimized with Sodium, Iris, and Distant Horizons for massive render distances and high performance.  
- Building Versatility: Use FramedBlocks, Chipped, and Rechiseled to design highly detailed space stations and bases.

### Distribution and Editing
- Redistribution: You are not permitted to re-upload, redistribute, or host this modpack on any platform.
- Personal Use: You are permitted to edit the files for your own private, personal gameplay. However, you may not publish or distribute these modified versions.
